verdict.rationale: Homebrew's Brewfile/`brew bundle` system lets users install, dump, check, and exec bulk sets of formulae, casks, taps, and other package types in one command, and `NONINTERACTIVE=1` supports scripted/automated bulk runs — a clear bulk-operation capability for an AI-native/automation user. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specifically of `brew bundle` bulk workflows (community evidence instead centers on unwanted bulk side-effects during `brew upgrade`), and no explicit API/programmatic bulk interface beyond the CLI.
